title: Credit Calculation Note — The Residential Natural Gas Supply Renewal Loyalty Credit Amount
content:
The Residential Natural Gas Supply renewal loyalty credit is the renewal loyalty credit amount of the plan in force, posted once as a negative renewal loyalty credit. It is stated in US dollars and rounded half up to the cent.

```
Input     the plan named on the agreement record (after a renewal, the plan renewed into)
Read      that plan's one-time renewal loyalty bill credit: the plan amount
Output    the credit owed, in US dollars rounded half up to the cent, posted as a negative renewal loyalty credit
```

*Worked figure (hypothetical plan amount).* A renewed term on a plan whose renewal loyalty credit amount is 25.00: the credit owed is 25.00, posted as a renewal loyalty credit line of minus 25.00.
